title: Discord rolls out its updated age-verification policy this week, sorting users into either the Adult or Teen group based on account age, activity levels, more (Anna Washenko/Engadget)
summary: Anna Washenko / Engadget: Discord rolls out its updated age-verification policy this week, sorting users into either the Adult or Teen group based on account age, activity levels, more — It will offer several privacy-focused options for users who aren't automatically confirmed as adults.
